verdict.rationale: Netlify docs mention prompting AI agents from the dashboard and connecting AI assistants to accounts for deployment workflows, plus an AI Gateway and llms.txt for LLM discoverability, suggesting some natural-language/agentic control surface exists. However there's no concrete evidence of a chat-style natural-language command interface across the full product (e.g., 'deploy this site' via NL) — most control is via CLI/API/dashboard rather than NL commands. Missing for 10: hands-on demonstration of natural-language command execution, documentation of a conversational interface, and independent corroboration beyond marketing copy.
